headline: Board of Water Supply Rejects Bill 1 CD1, Reviews West Maui Wells

meeting.body: Board of Water Supply Rejects Bill 1 CD1, Reviews West Maui Wells
meeting.summary: The Board of Water Supply voted not to support Bill 1 and heard a timeline for new West Maui wells.
meeting.recap: A resident suggested new West Maui pools could mainly use captured rainwater rather than drinking water.[[0:04:38]] Another testifier opposed the Bill 1 amendment, saying the water department should keep its discretion.[[0:09:44]] A motion was made to tell Council Member Cook's office the board does not support Bill 1.[[0:33:31]] The motion passed with five ayes.[[0:35:25]] Board members agreed to hold that item for a future meeting.[[0:39:57]] Staff presented a timeline for new West Maui water source projects.[[0:48:19]] The Kahana well is projected to be finished in the fourth quarter of this year.[[0:49:04]] The well called H2 is projected to be finished in early 2032.[[0:54:31]] Staff said the L1 and H1 wells are fully funded.[[0:57:09]] The director said a desalination report can't be released until the Department of Homeland Security approves it.[[1:05:54]] The next board meeting is October 15 at 1:30 p.m.[[1:07:21]] The board voted, with five ayes, to ask the planning director to respond to the board's letter.[[1:20:38]] The board voted unanimously to ask the planning and water supply directors to jointly explain their roles in subdivision water supply.[[1:23:16]]
decided: The board voted to ask the planning director to respond to the board's letter.
The board voted to ask the planning director and the water supply director to jointly attend a meeting to explain their roles in securing water supply for subdivision applications.
meeting.next: The chair said she will talk with the director about the list of requested reports and when they can be put on an agenda.
